concerns.text: T001’s verification step runs the full pipeline (`python -m code.pipeline.run_all ...`) and expects a successful end‑to‑end run log. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency because the full pipeline relies on artifacts produced by later tasks (T002‑T010) which have not yet been generated at the point T001 is scheduled.

Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it writes to shared artifacts such as `data/checksums.sha256` and `data/results/run_log.txt`. Running it in parallel with any other task that also writes to these locations would cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T010 is also tagged `[P]` yet it appends to `data/checksums.sha256` and creates `data/results/final_report.md`. These files are also written by earlier tasks, so parallel execution could corrupt the checksum manifest or report. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the task re‑structured to avoid shared‑state writes.
